Dmitri Bello
dmitri.bello@example.com | Salt Lake City, UT
Dmitri Bello has 6 years of experience in mobile. Most recently, Senior Mobile
Engineer at Silverline Digital (2023-2026), where they built the company's
React Native app end to end, shipped to 203K users. Before that, Mobile
Engineer at Quartzline Dynamics (2021-2023). Before that, Junior Mobile
Engineer at Crestline Dynamics (2020-2021). Education: M.S. Computer
Engineering, DePaul University, 2019; B.S. Computer Engineering, Boston
University, 2016. Core skills: React Native, REST API design, Swift, REST API
design, Node.js, TypeScript.
